metaTitle: VReRV — Building how people and AI agents work together
metaDescription: VReRV builds collaboration tools that don't lose context: Collavre, which merges docs, tasks and conversation into one tree, plus Danvre, Tank Echo, Magic Duel and our open source.
heroBodyBefore: VReRV builds collaboration tools that don't lose context. Our flagship is
heroBodyAfter: , which merges docs, tasks and conversation into a single tree. Experiments ship as small products and open source.

collavre.tagline: Docs, tasks and conversation in one tree.
collavre.body: Write it once. Every block is a document, a task and a thread at the same time. Progress rolls up on its own, and that same structure becomes the context you hand to an AI agent.
collavre.bullet1: Hierarchical blocks with automatic progress rollup
collavre.bullet3: Real-time chat on every block · self-hostable

danvre.body: Dance along to a video and the camera scores your pose, movement and timing. Video and pose data never leave your browser.

tank.body: Battleship meets bingo, in 3D. Fire along your line of sight and read row, column and diagonal hints to find the hidden tanks. No sign-up.

magic.body: Real-time 1v1 spell duels. Combine prisms into spells and counter what your opponent throws next.

opensourceSubtitle: Tools we split out while building our products.

repo.rails_mcp_engine: An MCP server engine for Rails. Sorbet · RubyLLM · FastMCP.
repo.md-to-notion: Upload a folder of markdown as a Notion page tree.
repo.openapi-markdown: Turn an OpenAPI spec into readable markdown docs.
repo.cli-openai-proxy: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for agent CLIs like Claude Code and Codex. BYOK, self-hosted.

companyBody: VReRV looks for more efficient ways to build software, makes technology usable by more people, and searches for the shape of AI that helps everyone.
